npcdata/094.edt: You are new around here. I am Vasko, I keep an eye on the square.
Back again? The square has not moved since you left.
Fine weather for walking, if you like dust.
Every road out of here leads to more dust.
I have no use for that.
Ask a clear question and you get a clear answer.
Threats do not frighten an old man with nothing to lose.
I am too old to carry a rifle for you.
Go well.
Enough talk. Leave me be.
Strangers with guns usually mean trouble for the square.
Still, you look like you can keep your word.
You came back. Have you seen the old hermit yet?
The well water is sweeter since the rains came.
There is a hermit in the hills nobody has seen for a month.
If you find him, tell me he is alive.
Wait here. I want to show you something by the trees.
Follow me, quietly now.
From here you can see the path to the hills. That is where he went.
That is all you get from me today.
Tell me the truth: did the soldiers send you here?
Then I have nothing more to say to you.
Good. I did not think you were one of them.
You are lying, and you lie badly.
Perhaps you are telling the truth after all.
Spare rounds? My old pistol will thank you. I will keep them.
Money for the square. It will buy seed for the gardens.
Keep your pistol. I want no guns in my hands.
npcdata/065.edt: Haven't seen you in town before. The name is Marsh.
I keep my rifle oiled and my mouth shut.
Keep it, I have no use for that.
Ask what you came to ask.
Easy. Nobody needs to get hurt here.
I did some soldiering once. I might do some more, for the right people.
I'm no volunteer. Pay me every day and I'll follow you anywhere.
Word is the soldiers pulled out of the hills to the south.
Deal. Let me get my gear.
npcdata/123.edt: Please, are you going east? I need to get out of this town.
The road east is not safe for a woman alone.
My cousins keep a farm two valleys away.
I can't take that from you.
I only want to go home.
Please, I have done nothing to you!
I would only slow you down.
I have waited three weeks for someone to take me along.
Will you take me with you? I promise I won't slow you down.
Let's keep moving, I don't like it here.
Here? All right, I'll find my own way from here.
My cousins will feed you well if we ever get there.
npcdata/087.edt: Welcome to my club. Mind the sawdust, it hides the teeth.
You look like you can throw a punch. Want to try one of my lads in the ring?
The lads train every afternoon. The crowd only comes for blood.
Suit yourself. The ring will still be here tomorrow.
Step into the ring when you are ready. Fists only, and stay inside the ropes.
That is not boxing. Get out of my ring, the bout is off.
Bell! That is the end of it.
Now that is how it is done. The crowd will talk about this one.
You will feel that tomorrow. Come back when the swelling is gone.
